title: Close both settings wire clients when one close fails
outcome: Close both settings wire clients when one close fails
acceptance: The task-sync instruction wire fixture attempts to close both MCP clients even if one close rejects, and retains both close diagnostics while fixture cleanup always runs.
A regression exercises writer-close rejection and proves the reader close is still attempted without leaving a live fixture process.

completion.summary: Closed both settings wire clients through the existing aggregate shutdown helper, with real-process regressions proving writer failure cannot skip reader cleanup and both diagnostics survive.
